name: HENGCE Q017 Authority Guard

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'hengce/q017_radar/latest.json'
      - 'hengce/q017_radar/decision/**'
      - 'hengce/q017_radar/observations/**'
      - 'hengce/q017_radar/observation_latest.json'
      - 'scripts/hengce_q017_authority_guard.py'
      - 'scripts/hengce_q017_decision_lock.py'
      - 'scripts/hengce_q017_authority_guard_v4.py'
      - 'scripts/hengce_q017_decision_lock_v4.py'
      - 'scripts/hengce_q017_observation_lock_v5.py'
      - 'scripts/hengce_q017_authority_guard_v5.py'
      - 'scripts/test_hengce_q017_adversarial_v4.py'
      - 'hengce/HENGCE_DAILY_COMMAND_CENTER_CONTRACT_v1_4_20261019.json'
      - '.github/workflows/hengce-q017-authority-guard.yml'

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: hengce-q017-authority-guard
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  guard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install runtime dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check requests openpyxl

      - name: Self-test schema-v5 guard
        run: |
          python scripts/hengce_q017_observation_lock_v5.py --mode self-test
          python scripts/hengce_q017_authority_guard_v5.py --mode self-test

      - name: Enforce formal Q017 schema-v5 observation-bound authority
        run: python scripts/hengce_q017_authority_guard_v5.py --mode check-and-repair

      - name: Commit fail-closed repair if needed
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name 'hengce-authority-guard-bot'
          git config user.email 'hengce-authority-guard-bot@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add hengce/q017_radar/latest.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'Q017 schema-v5 authority is already valid.'
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m 'HENGCE Q017 schema-v5 authority guard: quarantine unauthorized latest output'
          if ! git push origin HEAD:main; then
            git pull --rebase origin main
            python scripts/hengce_q017_authority_guard_v5.py --mode check-and-repair
            git add hengce/q017_radar/latest.json
            if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
              git commit --amend --no-edit
            fi
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
